Bring a full spectrum infrared sauna experience home with the Golden Designs Maxxus MX-M356-01-FS CED, a 3-person corner indoor sauna crafted from natural Canadian Red Cedar. This space-efficient corner unit combines Near, Mid, and Far infrared heat, near-zero EMF PureTech™ heaters, soothing chromotherapy lighting, and modern touchscreen controls in a compact 60" x 60" footprint that fits well in a master bath, wellness room, or home gym.

Designed for comfortable shared use, the corner layout makes the most of limited floor space while still delivering a generous interior (approximately 56" x 56" x 68"). The warm tone and natural aroma of reforested Canadian Red Cedar create an inviting retreat the moment you step inside. Bronze-tinted tempered glass and side windows provide a sense of openness while maintaining privacy, so you can relax without feeling closed in.

The MX-M356-01-FS CED is a full spectrum infrared sauna, combining Near, Mid, and Far infrared wavelengths in one unit. PureTech™ near-zero EMF carbon panels deliver deep, even Far infrared warmth, while Near infrared elements add surface-level heat and light for a more complete session. Together, these technologies support deep, comfortable sweating and a gentle warming from the inside out, making this sauna suitable for both post-workout recovery and end-of-day relaxation.

A total of 9 heating elements are strategically placed throughout the cabin: 3 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR infrared carbon panels and 6 Near infrared elements. This configuration is designed to surround users with consistent heat from multiple angles, including the back, sides, and lower body. The sauna’s typical operating range is around 118°F–132°F, with the ability to reach approximately 140°F, allowing you to choose between milder, meditative warmth or more intense sweat sessions based on your comfort level and preferences.

Controls are kept simple with an interior touch screen control panel. From inside the sauna, you can adjust temperature and session time without opening the door, helping maintain heat and efficiency. For entertainment and relaxation, the unit includes an integrated FM radio, Bluetooth audio connectivity, MP3 auxiliary input, and built-in speakers, so you can enjoy music, podcasts, or guided meditations while you unwind.

Lighting is an important part of the experience in this model. Inside, an oversized chromotherapy lighting system lets you choose from various color settings to match your mood. In current model years, the unit also incorporates an integrated red light feature, giving you another light-based wellness option within the same cabin. On the outside, accent lighting provides a clean, finished appearance and enhances the look of the sauna in your space, especially in low-light environments or evening use.

The Maxxus MX-M356-01-FS CED is designed strictly for indoor use and features a clasp-together assembly system that helps streamline installation. The panels are built to fit together with minimal visible hardware, giving the sauna a furniture-like finish once assembled. In operation, the unit runs on a dedicated 120V / 20A non-GFCI circuit, which means it can be powered from standard residential service (with the correct 20A outlet and breaker, installed by a qualified electrician) rather than requiring a 240V connection.

In terms of overall build, this sauna weighs approximately 380 lbs, with a shipping weight of about 545 lbs distributed across three cartons to make handling and delivery more manageable. A floor heater is included to help keep lower-body heat consistent with the warmth at upper seating level, and a roof vent allows for quick fresh-air adjustment if you prefer a small amount of airflow during your session.

From the solid Canadian Red Cedar construction to the near-zero EMF heating system and thoughtful touches such as bronze-tinted glass, corner footprint, and integrated audio and lighting, the Maxxus MX-M356-01-FS CED is built as a long-term indoor wellness fixture. It is distributed through major retailers and backed by a manufacturer’s warranty, offering a combination of aesthetic appeal, modern infrared technology, and brand-backed support for homeowners who want to move beyond basic portable saunas and invest in a more permanent, furniture-grade infrared sauna for everyday use.
